title: Direct and Indirect Speech: Wh Questions — Quiz 131

## Direct and Indirect Speech: Wh Questions

Choose the correct connector when reporting why and how questions.

### Lesson focus

1. I said to him, “Why are you looking through the keyhole?”
2. She said to her neighbour, “How can I tame my husband?”

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
